subject: Re: Redwood DPA — international transfer wording and DocuSign execution
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finco.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: tom.baker@finco.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Redwood DPA - transfers / UK IDTA / execution

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the DPA — attached are our redlines (FinCo_DPA_Redlines_v1.pdf). We have three items we need to confirm before we can proceed to e-sign:  

1) International transfer wording: we need explicit language that references the EU SCCs and a UK IDTA addendum (or equivalent binding mechanism) and a bridging clause for onward transfers to subprocessors. Our regulator expects clear mapping to SCCs + a UK addendum. Please advise if Redwood can:  
   - Confirm you will execute the SCCs with us (or provide an equivalent mechanism) and add the UK IDTA addendum; and
   - Include the bridging language we proposed in Section 7.

2) Subprocessors: please provide the most recent subprocessors list and confirm you will notify us 30 days before adding any subprocessors that process EU/UK personal data.

3) Execution mechanics: FinCo uses DocuSign and requires a signed addendum (if any) attached to the DPA. Please confirm you can execute via DocuSign and whether Redwood will use its standard embedded sign/countersign flow or if you prefer us to initiate.

Also, we have two minor redlines around the data retention/audit log language — see the annotated PDF. Can you get back to us by end of week? Our procurement timeline is tight.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Senior Legal Counsel | FinCo Payments
elena.rossi@finco.com

Attachments: FinCo_DPA_Redlines_v1.pdf

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finco.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA - transfers / UK IDTA / execution

Elena — thanks, and appreciate the clear notes. Looping in Rishi (legal) and Mina (security/ops) to address the redlines and the transfer/IDTA questions. Quick summary and proposed next steps:  

- Subprocessors: attached is our current list (redwood_subprocessors_list_2026-06.pdf). We'll confirm the 30-day notice commitment can be added as a contractual schedule item.
- SCCs + UK IDTA: we can sign the EU SCCs and add Redwood's UK IDTA addendum as an executed attachment. Rishi, can you confirm whether the bridging clause language proposed by FinCo is acceptable as-is or whether legal prefers the alternate phrasing in the attached track changes?
- DocuSign execution: we can accept DocuSign. We typically initiate from Redwood's account (embedded signing, then countersign) to keep the document bundle intact, but happy for FinCo to initiate if you prefer.

Proposed timeline: we will turn around a track-changes DPA with proposed language for the transfer clause by EOD Wednesday (UK time), and then if accepted we can prepare a DocuSign envelope the same day for signature. Does that timeline work?

I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth so procurement has visibility.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_subprocessors_list_2026-06.pdf

From: Tom Baker <tom.baker@finco.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:20:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Redwood DPA - transfers / UK IDTA / execution

Marissa — quick question from procurement: the auditor on our side asked whether Redwood can commit to preserving per-tenant audit logs for 12 months for requests and configuration changes tied to EU customer data. The DPA's current audit language looks more general. Can your security team confirm a written SLA/commitment around that?

If Redwood cannot add a hard 12-month retention promise in the DPA, would a SOC2 + a DocuSign-stamped annex with our requested retention commitment work? We need something we can show the regulator.

Thanks,
Tom Baker
Procurement Lead | FinCo Payments

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finco.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@finco.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 14:55:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Redwood DPA - transfers / UK IDTA / execution

Hi Elena / Tom — thanks for the detail. A few points from legal/security:  

1) SCCs & UK IDTA addendum: Redwood can execute the EU SCCs (we'll attach them as an annex) and also add our standard UK IDTA addendum. I've included proposed alternative wording below that keeps the substantive protection FinCo requested while ensuring compatibility with Redwood's broader subprocessor model:

   Proposed transfer clause (suggested):
   "Where Transfers are governed by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or the UK International Data Transfer Agreement (IDTA), the Parties agree that the relevant SCCs/IDTA shall be executed as an Annex to this DPA. Redwood will apply a bridging clause to authorize onward transfers to subprocessors performing services under this Agreement, provided that Redwood requires equivalent safeguards and enters into written agreements with such subprocessors that reflect the applicable SCCs/IDTA obligations."

   This preserves the regulator-facing reference to SCCs/IDTA while allowing standard subprocessors' workflow. If FinCo prefers the exact phrasing in your redlines, we can discuss narrow edits.

2) Subprocessor notice: we confirm we will add a 30-day prior notice requirement for additions that will process EU/UK personal data. We'll add that to the DPA schedule.

3) Audit logs / retention: Mina — can you confirm operational feasibility for a 12-month per-tenant audit log retention for the categories Tom mentioned? If not, propose an alternative commitment the customer can present to regulators (e.g., SOC2 report + archived logs retained for 12 months in read-only export on request).

4) Execution flow: Redwood will initiate DocuSign from our account (embedded sign then countersign). We'll send the envelope to the signatories Tom / Elena nominate and provide the link back if you prefer to initiate.

I'm attaching the DPA with our track changes (redwood_dpa_v3_track_changes.pdf). Please review the suggested transfer clause above and let us know. We'll aim to finalize language and send for signature once we have FinCo's confirmation on the transfer clause and retention path.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_dpa_v3_track_changes.pdf

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finco.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Baker <tom.baker@finco.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:05:00 +0100
Subject: RE: Redwood DPA - transfers / UK IDTA / execution

Rishi / Marissa — thank you, that proposed clause looks acceptable in principle. Two small follow-ups:  

- For audit logs, FinCo prefers a contractual 12-month retention commitment for the specific event categories (access, configuration, data export). If Redwood cannot commit in the DPA, please confirm the SOC2 + on-request export mechanism and timeframe for delivery. We may accept the latter if backed by an SLA.
- DocuSign: FinCo will allow Redwood to initiate the envelope. Please address the envelope to me (elena.rossi@finco.com) and Tom (tom.baker@finco.com). We'll countersign and return.

If you can send the final track-changed DPA incorporating the proposed transfer clause + 30-day subprocessor notice and either the audit retention commitment or a clear SLA, we'll get procurement to sign within 48 hours.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best regards,
Elena
